title: Conditions for Revoking Taxi Driver's Vocational Licence
what_it_is: Conditions for Revoking Taxi Driver's Vocational Licence

sections.label: Taxi licence revocation grounds
sections.summary: A taxi licence can be revoked for disqualification, serious crimes, over 20 demerit points, or physical unfitness, with 14 days to appeal.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: The licence can be revoked if the driver is disqualified from driving by the Singapore Traffic Police or by a Court of law, if he is convicted for committing serious crimes, if he has been given more than 20 demerit points for misconduct, or if he is assessed to be physically unfit to be a taxi driver.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Transport (Mrs Josephine Teo) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Upon notification, the taxi driver has 14 days to appeal, during which, mitigating circumstances or any new information would be considered.

sections.label: Appeal to Transport Minister
sections.summary: A licence holder whose licence LTA revoked may appeal to the Minister for Transport, and LTA is still establishing the facts of this case.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Ms Sylvia Lim, in her supplementary question alluded to an outstanding case by a particular appellant.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: I would say that if LTA has revoked the licence holder's licence, even after the licence holder has put in an appeal, the holder may then put in an appeal to the Minister for Transport.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: LTA is still establishing the facts of this case, and we can review the appropriate course of action, including whether to reinstate his licence when we have greater clarity on the details of the case.

sections.label: Passenger safety in licence revocation
sections.summary: LTA considers passenger safety and potential risks, and revocation conditions include demerit points, offences committed, and physical unfitness.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: An important consideration that the LTA has is the safety of the passengers and the potential risks.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: So, if she would like to discuss a specific instance, I suggest we take it offline.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: But as a general policy, we will have to look at the facts of the case, and the conditions under which a taxi driver's vocational licence may be revoked is made quite clear, including accumulation of demerit points, offences being committed and physical unfitness.
